name: @s1oopx/pi-studio-dev
description: Windows desktop workspace for the Pi coding agent
author: s1oopX <s1oopp1337@gmail.com>

scripts.build:renderer: cd renderer-next && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --dir --win --x64 --config.electronDist=../../node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.pack:offline: npm run build:renderer:offline && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --dir --win --x64 --config.electronDist=../../node_modules/electron/dist --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.pack:portable: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.electronDist=../../node_modules/electron/dist
